text: Code reviews are a vital part of software development. When developers review each other’s code, they can catch bugs early, before these problems reach the final product. This saves both time and money, as fixing an issue later is much more difficult. Beyond finding mistakes, code reviews encourage knowledge sharing among team members. A junior developer can learn new techniques from a senior, while a senior might see a fresh, creative approach. Most importantly, this practice builds a sense of shared responsibility. The team works together to improve quality, creating better software and a stronger, more collaborative environment for everyone.
